name: giant shark
desc: A giant shark is 30 feet long and normally found in deep oceans. Utterly fearless, it preys on anything that crosses its path, including whales and ships.

special_abilities.name: blood frenzy
special_abilities.desc: The shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

special_abilities.name: water breathing
special_abilities.desc: The shark can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.
